name: ntr_db_unique_regions
xsql:
select count(*) count from (
select distinct pa.region from xactly.xc_participant pa where employee_id in 
  (
    select employee_id from xactly.xc_participant where participant_id in  :v_child_master_participant_id
  ) 
and :v_qtr_start_date between pa.effective_start_date and pa.effective_end_date
   )
